Oracle's combined net income for fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 was $12,443 million for 2025 and $17,087 million for 2026, for a total of $29,530 million. (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules)
Nasdaq's operating income increased from $1,798 million in 2024 to $2,331 million in 2025, an increase of $533 million. (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements)

Microsoft's total current assets as of June 30, 2026, were $207,710 million, and its total current liabilities as of June 30, 2026, were $168,825 million. Therefore, Microsoft's current ratio as of June 30, 2026, was $207,710 million / $168,825 million, which equals 1.23. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA)

The total net income for 2023, 2024, and 2025 is $10,981,201 + $8,711,631 + $5,407,990 = $25,100,822 thousand. (Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF COMPREHENSIVE INCOME)

The total amount paid of $601 million was recorded in retained earnings in the Consolidated Balance Sheets at December 31, 2025, as dividends paid (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity). The total purchase price (in millions) — Year Ended December 31, 2025, was $616 million, as share repurchases (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > Nasdaq Stockholders’ Equity). Therefore, Nasdaq returned a total of $601 million + $616 million = $1,217 million to shareholders in 2025 through dividends paid and share repurchases combined.
Microsoft's net income increased by $31,917 million from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA)

Oracle's net income as a percentage of its total revenues in fiscal 2026 was 25.8%.
